name: Grant Kaufmann
intro: I’m a third-year Mechanical Engineering student at Harvard College, Class of 2028. I build across mechanics, electronics, and software—from the first CAD sketch to the workbench.
bio: My experience spans independent projects, research at Harvard’s Rowland Institute, a SpaceX internship, and leadership in the Harvard Undergraduate Robotics Club. I’m also a Midshipman in NROTC.
